def bars():
    f=current_frame; rows=f.ascii.split('\n')
    y=sum(1 for r in range(64) if rows[r][63]=='Y')

    return y,o,ys

action(['DOWN'])
print("after DOWN:",bars())
action(['DOWN'])
print("after DOWN2:",bars())
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
